_doc: One row per game system. Each row is one script. 'reads' lists the sheets/rows it is generated from; 'status' goes planned -> written -> tested (in the running game).

rows.does: parses --data, --rust, --cs2 from OS.get_cmdline_user_args(); derives Steam userdata from the CS2 folder; refuses to start with a clear message if a folder is missing
rows.evidence: tested: release build launched with --data/--rust/--cs2, and from the clean install folder

rows.does: loads each content.json row's 'out' file from the data folder at runtime (obj/png/wav/mp3/glb/json) and caches it; missing file = visible error listing the row id
parses vcfg (user then default), maps each input.json row to a Godot InputMap action; reads sensitivity/m_yaw/crosshair convars
rows.evidence: tested: CS2 defaults loaded; mouse 600 counts -> 33.0 deg yaw (0.022 x 2.5)

rows.does: Source movement: CategorizePosition (normal.y >= 0.7 = ground), Friction, Accelerate, AirAccelerate(cap 30u), TryPlayerMove with ClipVelocity (4 bumps, 5 planes), StepMove, jump, duck; fixed 64 Hz
rows.evidence: tested: bot surfs r1-r4 to 1604 u/s; duplicate-plane rampbug fixed

rows.does: builds one node per course.json row: ramps as ArrayMesh prisms + ConcavePolygonShape3D, platforms as boxes, zones as Area3D; applies materials.json; spawn + world_offset_rust
rows.evidence: tested: all rows built; bot completes course

rows.does: places the real Launch Site meshes from launch_site_placements.json (Unity LH -> Godot RH: z = -z, quat (x,y,z,w) -> (-x,-y,z,w)), render only, no collision in v1
starts on leaving start zone, stops in end zone, splits at checkpoints; stores best time per course in user://pb_<course>.json
rows.evidence: tested: start on leaving zone, cp split, PB saved 19.70 s

rows.does: entering a checkpoint saves respawn point; kill zone or key teleports there with velocity zeroed
rows.evidence: tested: kill floor returns to cp1

rows.does: records pos+yaw every tick; on new PB saves user://ghost_<course>.json; plays back as translucent capsule each run
rows.evidence: tested: PB ghost visible in recorded run

rows.does: loads the CS2 arms + knife glb on their own skeletons, drives them with the clip AnimationPlayer (draw -> idle loop, inspect on +lookatweapon), and pins the knife to the wpn bone each skeleton update
one AudioStreamPlayer per sounds.json row; footstep/land/jump from SurfPlayer signals; speed_wind volume follows speed; Rust music plays on finish and stops on restart
speed (u/s like surf servers), timer, PB, checkpoint, CS2-style crosshair drawn from convars, error overlay
rows.evidence: tested: speed, timer, PB, crosshair from convars

rows.does: run once by Melty before first start: extracts every content.json row from the player's Rust and CS2 installs into the data folder, writes done-<version>.txt; logs to prep.log; never copies anything it doesn't need
rows.evidence: tested: clean install from RustSurf-0.1.0.zip, bundled Python, 75 s, missing none; game then completed the course from that install

rows.does: loadout (primary, pistol, knife) on the CS2 arms, hitscan fire with items_game.txt stats, ammo, reload, recoil punch, B buy menu
rows.evidence: 2026-10-09: knife equip renders; ray and hit() contract tested headless (--wtest); guns need the PC prep export

rows.does: F2 aim-train arena: flick, tracking and bot targets, round scoring, best per mode
rows.evidence: 2026-10-09: arena rendered (shots lobby); hits and shots counted in --wtest

rows.does: Esc menu: pause, sensitivity, fov, viewmodel, volume, crosshair; saves only what the player changed
rows.evidence: 2026-10-09: menu rendered with --menu; values applied through Viewmodel.set_view and Hud convars
